info.title: Music Room API
info.description: REST/JSON API. Real time: WebSocket /ws — send {"action":"auth","token"} then {"action":"subscribe","channel":"event:1|playlist:1|device:1"}; server pushes {channel,type:"state",data}. Mobile apps should send headers X-Platform, X-Device-Model, X-App-Version (logged server side).

Error.description: All errors: {"error":{"code":"FORBIDDEN","message":"..."}} with the HTTP status 400/401/403/404/409/429/500

token.description: Bearer token to send in Authorization

dev_verify_token.description: dev mode only (no SMTP, not production)

PublicProfile.description: Profile of someone else: private info is never returned

voted.description: did the caller vote for it

queue.description: sorted: most votes first; equal scores: the track that reached the score first

version.description: edit counter, +1 per change (optimistic locking with expectedVersion)
